cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Concede the Point
cards.instruction: Get them to release one claim, advantage, or disputed victory without reopening the entire contest.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Change the holiday caption to say I found that restaurant. The rest of your itinerary credit can stay.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You complained about its menu all evening.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Finding and liking are separate claims. Please correct the first without rewriting the evening.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine: 'Pat found it; I paid for it'.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep that. Put both names in the caption, not just the photo tags. I'm not disputing the bill; I want the discovery in the sentence.
